# Vendored dependencies

`lz-string.cjs` is the unmodified `lz-string@1.5.0/libs/lz-string.js` distribution from https://unpkg.com/lz-string@1.5.0/libs/lz-string.js (MIT; see `lz-string.LICENSE`). It decodes Obsidian Excalidraw's `compressed-json` format through Node.js. Plain JSON boards need Python 3 only. No npm install or remote code loading is used by the refresh tool.

The Excalidraw Obsidian plugin is installed separately from its official repository/Obsidian marketplace, and is not redistributed here.
